coverage_summary: Reviewed all seven trajectories. The paper supports the main transformations, but several graph semantics, one model-input binding, and the Q&A task/phase coverage require revision.

findings.detail: The source documents assembly/serialization in traversal order, but does not state a two-operation sequence of selection followed by concatenation. The select call also does not establish that it reorders values.

evidence.quote: cells with their cell sentences { s i } n i =1 were assembled in pre-determined spatial order to construct one spatial sentence
All cell sentences in a tissue patch are then assembled into a 1D 'spatial sentence', where cells are serialized by proximitybased traversal.

findings.required_change: Represent this as one documented serialization/assembly boundary with traversal order, or provide source evidence that explicitly supports selection/reordering followed by concatenation.

findings.detail: The invocation assigns all five anchors to the select operation's forced_inclusions parameter, although the paper says one anchor is randomly selected. This parameter value implies simultaneous retention rather than a candidate pool.

evidence.quote: Traversal begins by randomly selecting one of five anchor points - the geometric center or the four corners.

findings.required_change: Remove forced_inclusions or leave it unspecified; represent the five anchors as candidates and retain random selection as the method.

findings.detail: The graph binds neighboring_t_cell_context as a supplied model input. The cited paper text identifies neighboring T cells as the cells whose expression is generated, and documents only a single unseen perturbed cancer cell as the inference input.

evidence.quote: During inference, TISSUENARRATOR was given a single unseen perturbed cancer cell and tasked with generating the gene expression of its neighboring T cells.

findings.required_change: Remove neighboring_t_cell_context from the model-input receipt unless separate source evidence establishes supplied target-neighbor context. Represent the neighboring T-cell expression as the generated result.

findings.detail: The Q&A trajectory collapses three explicitly distinct tasks into one generic qa_answer path, losing documented output branches for top-five cell classes, top-20 genes, and natural-language structure description.

evidence.quote: we constructed a proof-of-concept dataset covering three tasks: given the name of an anatomical structure, (1) return the top 5 most abundant cell types, (2) list the top 20 highly expressed genes, and (3) generate a natural-language description of the structure.
List the major cell classes present in the Dorsal peduncular area region from the mouse brain (include up to five).
Provide a concise scientific summary of the brain division 'cranial nerves' from the mouse brain.

findings.required_change: Add three task-specific Q&A branches or an explicitly documented opaque task router with separate output representations for cell-type ranking, gene ranking, and descriptive summarization.

findings.detail: The trajectory is labeled fine_tuning while its task configuration also claims held-out inference, and it contains only a generic query-to-answer flow. The paper explicitly separates task-specific fine-tuning from evaluation on held-out structures.

evidence.quote: We split the dataset by structure name, fine-tuned TISSUENARRATOR, and evaluated the model on questions derived from held-out structures.
Following large-scale training on spatial sentences, TISSUENARRATOR can be fine-tuned on smaller, task-specific datasets to extend its functionality beyond cell generation.

findings.required_change: Split the Q&A reconstruction into fine-tuning and inference trajectories, or designate this trajectory as inference and add a separate fine-tuning phase with the task-specific training examples.

findings.detail: The source calls τ a randomness-control parameter, but the invocation labels it as the catalog's temperature parameter. The numerical default is supported, while the temperature interpretation is not established.

evidence.quote: where D aj is the Euclidean distance between cell j and the anchor, and τ (default τ = 1 ) controls randomness.

findings.required_change: Record τ as a source-defined randomness parameter within the sampling method or distribution details, and leave temperature unset unless the paper equates τ with temperature.
